headlines.title_zh: 国际能源署：AI数据中心激增考验全球电网
headlines.title_en: IEA Sees Data Center Boom Pushing Power Grids to the Limit
headlines.event_summary_zh: 国际能源署发布《2026年世界能源展望》，预计至2030年数据中心耗电量翻倍至1000太瓦时，电网扩容面临供应链瓶颈
headlines.event_summary_en: The IEA's World Energy Outlook 2026 projects that AI-driven data center demand could double electricity consumption to 1,000 TWh by 2030. Supply chain constraints for critical equipment and grid expansion speeds are emerging as the primary bottlenecks for scaling AI infrastructure.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】国际能源署（IEA）在《2026年世界能源展望》报告：预测2030年数据中心用电量达1000太瓦时，强调电网与设备供应链制约
【起因与机理】AI算力扩张与全球电力系统规划之间的结构性矛盾
【关键数据与实测】行业趋势：算力投资与能源基建同步，电网投资额十年内预计上升75%。
【各方立场与态度】核心瓶颈：电力设备（铜、变压器、电缆）供应紧缺与电网扩容滞后。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] International Energy Agency (IEA) (World Energy Outlook 2026): Projects 1,000 TWh consumption by 2030; highlights grid and supply chain constraints
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Structural mismatch between AI compute demand and energy system capacity
[Key Metrics] Strategic shift: 75% rise in global grid spending projected over the next decade.
[Industry Impact & Outlook] Primary bottlenecks: supply chain constraints for critical electrical components and grid expansion.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: AI产业的竞争重心正从芯片算力向能源基建转移，电力可用性与并网能力将成为下一阶段算力中心选址与地缘布局的决定性因子。设备供应链的刚性约束表明，单纯的算力堆叠已进入“能源通胀”阶段，未来谁掌握电力资源冗余，谁即掌握行业准入权。
headlines.industry_impact_en: The competitive focus of the AI industry is shifting from raw compute to energy infrastructure, making power availability and grid access the primary determinants for data center siting. This supply-side constraint signals an 'energy inflation' phase for AI, where power redundancy becomes the ultimate gatekeeper for industry dominance.

headlines.title_zh: Canva上线AI关闭开关，响应用户反制
headlines.event_summary_zh: Canva推出生成式AI功能关闭选项，允许用户在设计中屏蔽AI工具及AI生成内容，平衡创意控制权
headlines.event_summary_en: Canva has introduced an 'off' switch for generative AI features, allowing users to disable tools like Magic Expand and its chatbot while retaining non-generative utilities like background removal. This move responds to user frustration over AI proliferation and introduces filters to limit AI-generated content in search results.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】Canva（图形设计平台）在平台账户设置页面：允许用户关闭生成式AI工具并降低AI内容可见度
【起因与机理】应对用户对过度AI化的抵制情绪与内容纯净度需求
【核心事实细节】功能区隔：明确划分生成式AI与基于现有资产的智能化编辑工具。
【各方立场与态度】市场策略：通过提供AI开关缓解付费与免费用户的技术负荷焦虑。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Canva (Design platform) (Account settings / Permission menu): Toggle for disabling generative AI and filtering AI content visibility
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Addressing user backlash against AI-heavy workflows and demand for human-centric content
[Key Fact Detail] Functional segmentation: Distinguishing generative AI from asset-based intelligent editing.
[Key Position & Outlook] Market strategy: Easing technological friction for both free and paid users.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 这是SaaS平台在AI过载期出现的典型修正行为，标志着从“全功能覆盖”向“用户体验颗粒度管理”的战略退让。平台若无法在AI生成效能与用户创作自治权之间取得平衡，将面临核心创意用户群流向纯手工工具的风险。
headlines.industry_impact_en: This is a typical corrective phase for SaaS platforms during the 'AI saturation' cycle, signaling a strategic retreat from aggressive feature integration toward granular user control. Failure to balance AI efficiency with creative autonomy risks alienating the core user base to competitors focusing on manual precision.

titans.name: OpenAI 官方
titans.role_zh: OpenAI 官方发布与模型前沿
titans.event_context_zh:
何其他单独的研究领域增长得更快。

本报告旨在提高研究加速的透明度，并为日益强大的人工智能的治理提供信息。我们认为，应该要求人工智能实验室跟踪并公开报告递归自我改进（RSI）指标：人工智能加速未来人工智能系统开发的过程。

我们希望这份扩展报告将有助于维持和推进整个行业的共享衡量规范。
titans.event_context_en:
We're sharing new data on how AI is changing research at OpenAI.

We find researchers' AI use continues to rise exponent
titans.quote_zh:
我们正在 OpenAI 上分享有关人工智能如何改变研究的新数据。

我们发现研究人员对人工智能的使用持续呈指数级增长，智能体正在完成更长的任务，但人类的参与仍然是研究的核心。研究人员也在安全和协调上花费了更多的时间，人类在这些领域的努力比任何其他单独的研究领域增长得更快。

本报告旨在提高研究加速的透明度，并为日益强大的人工智能的治理提供信息。我们认为，应该要求人工智能实验室跟踪并公开报告递归自我改进（RSI）指标：人工智能加速未来人工智能系统开发的过程。

我们希望这份扩展报告将有助于维持和推进整个行业的共享衡量规范。
titans.quote_en:
We're sharing new data on how AI is changing research at OpenAI.

We find researchers' AI use continues to rise exponentially, and agents are completing longer tasks, but human involvement remains central in research. Researchers are also spending more time on safety and alignment, with human effort in these areas growing faster than in any other individual research area.

This report aims to increase transparency around research acceleration and inform the governance of increasingly capable AI. We believe that AI labs should be required to track and publicly report indicators of recursive self-improvement (RSI): the process by which AI accelerates the development of future AI systems. 

Our hope is that this expanded report will help sustain and advance shared measurement norms across the industry.

https://t.co/xyGPcCkPCK
